blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — The Police Regional Office-Calabarzon (PRO-4A) has deployed more than 12,000 (12,297) personnel across the region. This action is for public safety during this year’s observance of ‘Undas’ (All Saints’ Day on Nov. 1 and All Souls’ Day on Nov. 2). PRO-4A said police forces across Cavite, Laguna, Batangas, Rizal and Quezon were placed on full alert starting Thursday, Oct. 29. The deployment includes 5,561 police officers, 1,218 augmentation personnel from other units, and 5,518 force multipliers. They will instill peace and order in cemeteries, memorial parks, columbaria, transport terminals, tourist destinations, major thoroughfares and other public convergence areas. […]...
